answer: Treat each identity as a vertex in a vouching graph, and weight its voting power by stake that ages like a glacier: only coins locked for months count fully, and unlocking resets the clock. A sybil nebula of fresh accounts, however many, earns almost nothing, since each needs its own long-locked deposit. Cloning 1,000 identities costs 1,000 deposits, plus months of lost yield, and any slashed vertex forfeits its stake.
